newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly up in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Wednesday closed slightly up by 0.21 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 582.84 from 581.62 on Tuesday.
Trade volume was 2.155 million dinars against 4.414 million dinars.
UBCI bank was down 1.56 dinar to 50.47 dinars. BNDT bank eased 0.86 dinar to 27.73 dinars. STB bank was down 0.7 dinar to 22.71 dinars.
Retail Stores Monoprix was up 0.9 dinar to 34.9 dinars. ($=one dinar)
